messages:
maria: quick idea — we should run a focused bakeoff comparing FP8 / INT8 / 4-bit on convo quality for our 2k-context chat workload. not perf-only: include instruction-following, long-history coherence, and hallucination rate. goal is to pick a candidate profile set for the canary.
josh: +1. what dataset + metric set are you thinking?
maria: propose 3 slices: (1) instruction-follow (LLMBench subset ~5k prompts), (2) multi-turn dialog (agg of support + devbot logs, ~3k sessions), (3) long-context synth (2000-token prompts w/ token perturbations). metrics: acceptability A/B (human), n-gram overlap (ROUGE), hallucination flag rate (rule-based), and latency p50/p95.
tara: add failure-mode counts: off-topic drift (classifier), truncated KV-cache misses, and token-level entropy shifts. also capture top-1 next-token disagreement between FP8/INT8 for a stratified 1k sample.
ken: we need an ops plan — GPU reservation + deterministic seeds so runs are comparable. recommend fixed batch=1, n_ctx=2048, temp=0.7, and warmup 5 tokens.
maria: agreed. bakeoff acceptance criteria (proposal): human A wins vs baseline OR <=0.5% BLEU drop WITH hallucination delta <=1% AND latency p95 <=1.25x baseline. if none meet, prefer INT8 with safety fallback.
josh: sounds reasonable. can we shadow-run fp8 w/ KV-cache enabled to see mismatch ops?
tara: yes but note fp8 has occasional headwise instabilities — capture headwise norm drift. also capture gradient-free saliency for a few examples to see attention pattern shifts.
ken: reserving 2x A100s for a 6h window. @ops-bot can you confirm node labels and image tag?
ops-bot: reserving nodes: a100-01,a100-02 for 6h starting now; image: rwinf/eval:quant-bakeoff-2026-03-21. Job dev tickets: INF-8421.
ken: thanks. QA checklist?
qa-bot: autop-run harness created: /infra/evals/quant/bakeoff_v2.yaml. It runs 3 repeats per profile, seeds [42,99,123], and uploads metrics to S3 prefix s3://rwinf-eval-results/quant/1759993333/.
maria: example run command (use this exact env):
```bash
./tools/run_eval.sh \
  --profile fp8 --model redwood-3b --ctx 2048 \
  --prompts data/conv_longctx/2000_prompts.jsonl \
  --out results/fp8_run.jsonl --seed 42
```
josh: can we also log raw logits to inspect low-prob token shifts? that'll be big but useful for analysis.
tara: compress logits per-turn; only keep top-10 deltas to save space. add a small checksum to each file so we can compare across runs.
maria: timeline: run today -> quick automated metric pass by QA tomorrow morning -> recruit 20 humans for A/B within 48h if automated signals ambiguous. if human A/B confirms candidate, schedule canary next week.
ken: risk: FP8 -> occasional repeat-loop hallucination on long-context; plan fallback: route 5% traffic to INT8 variant automatically if degscore > threshold.
josh: what degscore threshold do we use? propose degscore>0.12 (normalized) or hallucination rate >1.5x baseline.
maria: ok set threshold degscore=0.12 and hall_rate_mult=1.5. ops: ensure rollout policy is reversible and quick.
ops-bot: rollout policy template: canary=5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on metric breach. see /playbooks/rollouts/canary_template.md.
tara: small nit — document which layers we quantized (attn weights, ffn weights, layernorm scale-preserve flag). we need per-layer metadata in results.
maria: noted. I'll add a column in the results CSV: quantized_layers=attn,ffn,embed ; scale_preserve=true.
josh: who owns the human A/B? I can coord with UX research for 20 judges.
maria: thanks. owners: maria (experiment design), josh (human eval), tara (telemetry + analysis), ken (infra/run).
ken: action items repeated: 1) ops-bot reserve nodes (done) 2) qa-bot run harness -> upload raw results 3) maria kick runs and post S3 links 4) tara compute headwise drift and degscore 5) josh start recruit thread for A/B testers.
maria: cool. small running note: try one hybrid run where attn is INT8 but FFN is FP8 — might yield a good perf/quality tradeoff. label it "hybrid-attn-int8".
josh: +1 to hybrid probe. add to run matrix.
ken: will monitor. ping me if any job OOMs.
qa-bot: first batch started, ETA ~3h. progress log => 25% complete.
maria: :thumbsup: leave logs in s3 and slack me links. we'll reconvene after automated pass.
